description: Shuts down a running emulator (ending a profiling session on it first), saving its Quick Boot snapshot. Calling it again while it is shutting down (or once it is off) changes nothing; force: true kills one that is stuck shutting down. One this server did not boot (started from Android Studio or a terminal) needs confirm: true; ask the user before doing that. Device control.

avdName.description: AVD name from status, e.g. Pixel_9

confirm.description: Required for an emulator this server did not boot.

force.description: Kill an emulator that is stuck shutting down.

name: shutdown_emulator
title: Shut down an emulator
